title: Satwik-Chirag Triumph at China Masters, Eye Asian Games Encore
indian_angle: India's top men's doubles pair secured a significant title, boosting their confidence ahead of the Asian Games.
summary: Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty bounced back from a tough World Championship to win the China Masters, reigniting hopes for a strong performance at the Asian Games.

title: PV Sindhu Remains a Formidable Force for Asian Games Medal Hunt
indian_angle: Two-time Olympic medallist PV Sindhu is a key medal hope for India at her fourth Asian Games.
summary: PV Sindhu enters her fourth Asian Games with renewed confidence and fitness, aiming for a medal amidst tough competition in Aichi-Nagoya.

title: BAI Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course aims to enhance the coaching standards for Indian badminton at a national level.
summary: The Badminton Association of India is conducting an advanced Level-1 coaches course at National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14-23, 2026.

title: BAI Releases Regulations for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: These regulations are crucial for the organization and participation of Indian state teams in a key national event.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has published the official regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules for participation and competition.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This camp prepares India's promising young talent for major continental junior championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: Women’s Doubles Pair Change for World Junior Championships Trials
